text:
anya_cs: FYI Horizon Health reached out — they want to convert their 12mo commit to a 9mo term and pull the renewal forward by 45 days. Price increase accepted, but procurement needs a new PO schedule.
jordan_ae: ok, did they confirm exact start/end dates for the 9mo? we need to calc prorate.
anya_cs: customer says start = 2026-05-01, end = 2027-02-28. they want invoice split: 50% now, 50% at +90 days.
priya_finance: tagging procurement team later, but we need vendor code and a billing entity. Horizon's legal contact gave PO to "Horizon Health - North" — can we get vendor code? :thinking:
sam_legal: also need to confirm signer. CFO is traveling week of 4/12; they asked if VP Finance can sign. we can accept delegated signer but need a signed delegation form or explicit email from CFO.
jordan_ae: i'll ask the customer for the delegation email today. if we get it, we can proceed with Docusign.
signing-bot: DocuSign envelope created: env_0a9f — awaiting signer assignment. link: https://docusign.com/env/env_0a9f
priya_finance: for billing I'll prepare a split invoice template. put this in the invoice notes:
```
Invoice 1: 50% on 2026-05-01 - $45,000
Invoice 2: 50% on 2026-08-01 - $45,000
Contract term: 2026-05-01 to 2027-02-28 (9 months) - prorated from 12mo list price
```
anya_cs: account health note: usage dipped ~18% in March due to their infra migration. we promised enablement session to show batching/latency settings — schedule for next week if possible.
jordan_ae: i'll book an enablement call with eng-ops and their SRE for Tues 10am PT. please invite product specialist.
sam_legal: sample clause for delegation email: "I, [CFO Name], authorize [VP Finance Name] to sign on behalf of Horizon Health for the contract dated 2026-05-01." ask them to send from CFO email.
priya_finance: procurement asked for vendor code format; we told them HH-NORTH-XXXX. once they confirm vendor code we'll update billing entity.
anya_cs: next actions: 1) jordan get delegation email, 2) priya confirm vendor code and send invoice draft, 3) sam lock final signature wording, 4) i'll run the enablement and capture feedback form.
jordan_ae: got it. pinging the customer now.
signing-bot: Reminder scheduled: envelope env_0a9f will expire in 10 days. :alarm_clock:
priya_finance: if delegation email arrives, i'll move envelope to VP Finance and trigger the first invoice immediately.
anya_cs: noted. capturing customer feedback ask: we'll send a 3-question pulse after enablement (ease of setup, clarity of billing, support response). will include in post-call notes.
jordan_ae: i'll update the CRM with these next steps and set renewal checkpoint for 2026-11-01.
anya_cs: thanks team. keeping this thread as the single source for sign-off/procurement path. :thumbsup:
